name: CROMER RES (KENNETH)
address: 2777 NW THREE SISTERS DRIVE, BEND, OR 97703

fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance to help responders locate the property quickly from the road.
• Trim vegetation along both sides of the access drive to maintain clear width for emergency vehicles.
• Cut back dense vegetation that narrows or overhangs the access drive to allow full-size emergency vehicles to pass without obstruction.
• Clear a turnaround area near the residence large enough for an emergency vehicle to reverse direction without backing the full length of the driveway.
• Mark or designate a flat, firm staging area on the open lawn where responders can position equipment and personnel.
• Trim vegetation between the main residence and the detached structure to keep a clear path for responders moving between the two buildings.
• Keep a gate or opening at the rear of the property unlocked or clearly marked to allow responders to reach the rear of the residence on foot.
• Remove or thin dense vegetation that blocks sightlines from the access drive to the front entry, so arriving responders can see the main entrance immediately upon approach.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim tree branches and shrubs that are directly touching or overhanging the house on all sides.
• Thin the tree clusters nearest to the structure to create open gaps between individual trees.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against the foundation or walls of the house.
• Clear grass and low ground cover within several feet of the structure.
• Thin mixed vegetation between the tree clusters and the house to break up the continuous cover surrounding the structure.
• Remove dead grass, dead branches, and dry plant material from around the base of trees near the house.
• Trim overhanging branches along the full length of the driveway to keep it passable for vehicles.
• Keep the driveway surface clear of fallen branches, debris, and encroaching vegetation at all times.
• Mark the driveway entrance clearly so it is visible to responding vehicles approaching the property.
• Maintain the single access route free of any obstructions that could slow or block emergency vehicle entry or exit.
• Separate scattered shrubs from nearby trees by removing shrubs growing directly beneath tree canopies close to the structure.
• Keep grass mowed short around the house, especially where it connects to shrubs or tree bases.
